label: Under-5 mortality rate
caveat: Survival proxy for the adolescent cohort; not adolescent-specific.

label: Adolescent fertility rate
canonical_source: UN Population Division / World Bank SP.ADO.TFRT

label: Stunting prevalence, under-5
caveat: India value disputed against Poshan Tracker administrative data. See docs/CONTESTED.md.

label: Suicide mortality rate
canonical_source: WHO Global Health Estimates; NCRB for India
caveat: Registration completeness varies; under-reporting likely where suicide is stigmatised or criminalised.

label: Life evaluation (Cantril ladder)
canonical_source: Gallup World Poll via World Happiness Report
caveat: One perceptual question, ~1,000 respondents per country-year, 3-year mean, adults not adolescents. Construct validity contested. See docs/CONTESTED.md.

label: Child labour
caveat: Definitions differ across surveys; unpaid household work inconsistently captured.

label: Access to electricity
caveat: Population-level proxy. Connection is not reliable supply.

label: Harmonised learning outcome
canonical_source: Altinok, Angrist & Patrinos (2018) / World Bank HLO
caveat: Vintage 2005-2015. Imputed for 29 countries. China derives from PISA-participating provinces, not the national population.

label: Youth literacy rate 15-24
caveat: Self- or proxy-reported in several censuses.

label: Youth NEET rate
caveat: Subsistence and unpaid family work counted as employment in low-income settings depresses measured NEET.

label: Youth unemployment rate
caveat: Denominator is the labour force, so it rises where participation rises.

label: NEET gender gap
caveat: Inherits the comparability limits of the NEET series.

label: Active mobile broadband subscriptions
caveat: Subscriptions, not users; multi-SIM inflates this in some markets.
